## Volume I: Foundations {#volume-i}

Six quick challenges about data, memory, model size, and hardware limits.

::: {.mlsp-game-cards}

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/oom.html" aria-label="Play Tensor Tetris"><img src="/assets/games/previews/oom.jpg" alt="Tensor Tetris gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### Tensor Tetris
[Pack training memory before you OOM.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

Parameters anchor at the bottom; activations, gradients, and optimizer states fall in their real proportions. Activations dominate — and that's why you'll OOM.

[Play Tensor Tetris](/games/oom.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol1/">Vol I</a>: Training Memory Constraints</span></div>

:::
:::

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/prune.html" aria-label="Play Pulse Prune"><img src="/assets/games/previews/prune.jpg" alt="Pulse Prune gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### Pulse Prune
[Shrink a network without breaking it.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

A neural network on a canvas. You've got 45 seconds to remove most of the weights without crashing accuracy. The faint ones are safe; the bright ones are doing real work.

[Play Pulse Prune](/games/prune.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol1/">Vol I</a>: Model Compression &amp; Pruning</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>Operation</em> meets <em>Jenga</em></div>
:::
:::

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/quantization.html" aria-label="Play Quantization Sharp Shot"><img src="/assets/games/previews/quantization.jpg" alt="Quantization Sharp Shot gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### Quantization Sharp Shot
[Compress a model before the target blurs.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

Shoot a downrange target with per-layer precision dials as your sight. Lower precision saves bits but blurs, jitters, or drifts the target depending on which layer you compressed.

[Play Quantization Sharp Shot](/games/quantization.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol1/">Vol I</a>: Mixed-Precision Quantization</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>Silent Scope</em> meets <em>Duck Hunt</em></div>
:::
:::

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/batch.html" aria-label="Play Batch Size Balancer"><img src="/assets/games/previews/batch.jpg" alt="Batch Size Balancer gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### Batch Size Balancer
[Push throughput to the edge of OOM.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

A tug-of-war against time. Increase batch size to process more images per second, but watch the memory gauge—if it spikes into the red, you OOM and lose the run.

[Play Batch Size Balancer](/games/batch.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol1/">Vol I</a>: Throughput vs. Memory</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>Flappy Bird</em> (staying in the safe band)</div>
:::
:::

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/loader.html" aria-label="Play Data Loader Dash"><img src="/assets/games/previews/loader.jpg" alt="Data Loader Dash gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### Data Loader Dash
[The CPU preparing data before the GPU starves.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

Data blocks slide toward a glowing GPU. Type or tap the matching letter in the processing zone to prepare each block. Miss too many and the GPU starves.

[Play Data Loader Dash](/games/loader.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol1/">Vol I</a>: Data Engineering</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>Overcooked</em> meets <em>Typing of the Dead</em></div>
:::
:::

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/roofline.html" aria-label="Play Roofline Rider"><img src="/assets/games/previews/roofline.jpg" alt="Roofline Rider gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### Roofline Rider
[Ride from the memory limit to the compute limit.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

Ride a glowing kernel from the sloped memory limit to the flat compute limit. Steer toward the cyan roof, dodge stalls, and reach the finish line.

[Play Roofline Rider](/games/roofline.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol1/">Vol I</a>: Hardware Acceleration</span></div>

## Volume II: Scaling {#volume-ii}

Eight games about training and serving when one machine is not enough.

::: {.mlsp-game-cards}

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/lander.html" aria-label="Play Gradient Lander"><img src="/assets/games/previews/lander.jpg" alt="Gradient Lander gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### Gradient Lander
[Balance batch size and learning rate to converge safely.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

Pilot your model down the loss landscape to the global minimum. "Thrust" increases your Batch Size—giving you stable descent, but rapidly burning through your limited VRAM budget. Tilt to steer your Learning Rate. Hit the minimum too fast, or run out of VRAM, and your model diverges.

[Play Gradient Lander](/games/lander.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol2/">Vol II</a>: Large Batch Training &amp; Convergence</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>Lunar Lander (1979)</em></div>
:::
:::

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/pipeline.html" aria-label="Play Pipeline Pacer"><img src="/assets/games/previews/pipeline.jpg" alt="Pipeline Pacer gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### Pipeline Pacer
[Keep the GPUs fed without bubbling.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

Schedule micro-batches across four pipeline stages. If you send too many forwards, memory fills up; if you pause too long, later stages sit idle (pipeline bubble). Balance forward and backward scheduling to maximize throughput.

[Play Pipeline Pacer](/games/pipeline.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol2/">Vol II</a>: Pipeline Parallelism</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>Flight Control</em> meets <em>Overcooked</em></div>
:::
:::

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/moe.html" aria-label="Play MoE Router"><img src="/assets/games/previews/moe.jpg" alt="MoE Router gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### MoE Router
[Route tokens to the right experts before they expire.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

Colored tokens descend toward four experts. Press <kbd>1</kbd>–<kbd>4</kbd> or tap an expert to route the oldest token to its matching destination. A wrong route or a missed token ends the run.

[Play MoE Router](/games/moe.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol2/">Vol II</a>: Mixture of Experts</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>Missile Command</em> meets <em>Fruit Ninja</em></div>
:::
:::

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/checkpoint.html" aria-label="Play Checkpoint Roulette"><img src="/assets/games/previews/checkpoint.jpg" alt="Checkpoint Roulette gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### Checkpoint Roulette
[Fault tolerance and checkpointing at scale.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

Hold Spacebar to train, then release to save your progress. Each checkpoint pauses training while it writes; a node failure during the write restores the previous save. Reach 100% before the one-minute timer runs out.

[Play Checkpoint Roulette](/games/checkpoint.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol2/">Vol II</a>: Fault Tolerance</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>Push-Your-Luck</em></div>
:::
:::

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/allreduce.html" aria-label="Play All-Reduce Rhythm"><img src="/assets/games/previews/allreduce.jpg" alt="All-Reduce Rhythm gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### All-Reduce Rhythm
[Keep the gradients flowing in a perfect ring.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

GPUs are arranged in a ring. Follow the displayed GPU order and tap each one on the beat to send a gradient chunk. Miss a slot and your combo resets; the round ends after 30 seconds.

[Play All-Reduce Rhythm](/games/allreduce.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol2/">Vol II</a>: Collective Communication</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>Guitar Hero</em> meets <em>Pipe Mania</em></div>
:::
:::

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/topology.html" aria-label="Play Topology Tycoon"><img src="/assets/games/previews/topology.jpg" alt="Topology Tycoon gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### Topology Tycoon
[Build the fabric, avoid the bottlenecks.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

You have 8 GPUs and 20 seconds to build their network topology. Click between two nodes to toggle their connection: None, InfiniBand, or NVLink. Once the run phase begins, packets will flood the network. Maximize your delivered GB/s!

[Play Topology Tycoon](/games/topology.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol2/">Vol II</a>: Network Fabrics</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>SimCity</em> meets <em>Mini Motorways</em></div>
:::
:::

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/kvcache.html" aria-label="Play KV Cache Packer"><img src="/assets/games/previews/kvcache.jpg" alt="KV Cache Packer gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### KV Cache Packer
[Fit the prompts before memory fragments.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

A Tetris-like grid of requests. Place contiguous blocks to serve them. As they finish at different times, your memory fragments. Unlock Paged Mode to shatter requests into 1x1 blocks and defrag your cache!

[Play KV Cache Packer](/games/kvcache.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol2/">Vol II</a>: LLM Serving</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>Tetris meets Sandfall</em></div>
:::
:::

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/cluster.html" aria-label="Play Cluster Commander"><img src="/assets/games/previews/cluster.jpg" alt="Cluster Commander gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="720" height="432"></a>

### Cluster Commander
[Schedule jobs without fragmenting the fleet.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

Schedule 1x1, 2x2, and 4x4 jobs on an 8x8 GPU cluster. Don't let scattered small jobs fragment the cluster, or a massive 4x4 pre-training run will block the entire queue and kill your utilization!

[Play Cluster Commander](/games/cluster.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol2/">Vol II</a>: Fleet Orchestration</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>Block Puzzle</em></div>
:::
:::

## Volume III: Agentic Systems {#volume-iii}

Keep a digital agent's state useful and its tool actions recoverable.

::: {.mlsp-game-cards}
::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/context-cache.html" aria-label="Play Context Cache"><img src="/assets/games/previews/context-cache.jpg" alt="Context Cache gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="800" height="480"></a>

### Context Cache
[Keep the next action's evidence inside a limited working set.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

Pick the facts a tool call will need while a five-slot context budget forces you to evict the rest. Four short missions reveal whether the next step has enough evidence.

[Play Context Cache](/games/context-cache.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol3/">Vol III</a>: Context Working Sets</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>Inventory Puzzle</em></div>
:::
:::

::: {.mlsp-game-card}
<a class="mlsp-card-preview" href="/games/tool-trail.html" aria-label="Play Tool Trail"><img src="/assets/games/previews/tool-trail.jpg" alt="Tool Trail gameplay preview" loading="lazy" width="800" height="480"></a>

### Tool Trail
[What should an agent do when a tool call fails?]{.mlsp-card-tagline}

An agent's tool call failed. Retry it, undo a prior effect, or stop and inspect. A careless retry can duplicate a real-world change.

[Play Tool Trail](/games/tool-trail.html){.mlsp-card-cta}

::: {.mlsp-card-meta}
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>Read:</strong> <span><a href="/vol3/">Vol III</a>: Tool Actuation &amp; Recovery</span></div>
<div class="mlsp-meta-row"><strong>🕹️ Arcade DNA:</strong> <em>Choose Your Own Adventure</em></div>
:::
:::
:::

Dispatch physical actions before their deadlines and keep unsafe proposals from crossing the boundary.

[Keep the rover inside the safe set.]{.mlsp-card-tagline}
